members.title: ‘No real sense of appeal’: Vinted sellers complain of unfair account ‘bans’
members.description: Some users claim online marketplace’s automated systems stack odds against them when sales go wrong After Catherine Warrilow sold a Zara necklace for £6 on Vinted, she packed it up and posted it off, just as she had done with many things before.
